law_record.title: Driving upon sidewalk prohibited (1)
law_record.text: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 2 [(2) appended below], the driver of a vehicle shall not drive upon or within any sidewalk area except at a permanent or temporary driveway or alley entrance. A person who violates this subsection is guilty of a misdemeanor. The provisions of subsection 1 do not apply to a vehicle that is powered solely by electricity and designed to travel on three wheels when such a vehicle is operated: (a) As an authorized emergency vehicle; (b) By an officer or other authorized employee of a law enforcement agency, as that term is defined in NRS 239C.065, in the course of his or her official duties; or (c) By a security guard, as that term is defined in NRS 648.016, in the course of his or her official duties.

activation_conditions: the subject drives a vehicle onto or within a sidewalk area
exceptions: at a permanent or temporary driveway or alley entrance
a solely electric three-wheeled vehicle operated as an authorized emergency vehicle
the same vehicle operated by a law-enforcement officer or authorized employee in the course of official duties
the same vehicle operated by a security guard in the course of official duties
residue: 'in the course of his or her official duties' and the officer/security-guard status of the operator are interior facts no exterior observation supports; a three-wheeled electric vehicle's power source is likewise not observable, only its body
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: judged at every instant the footprint overlaps the sidewalk; a crossing at a driveway is excepted only while the footprint is within the driveway's own width
